title: Fit and finish, floor mats, and trunk fit
summary: This topic combines interior fit-and-finish comments with unrelated cargo-fit observations, with clear sentiment examples mainly covering dashboard trim praise, floor-mat fit complaints, and a window rattle.

positive.summary: The positive review praises the dashboard’s wood-grain finish as an appealing interior detail.

negative.summary: The negative reviews focus on poor overall fit and finish and a driver-side floor mat that is too small to cover the area properly.

mixed.summary: The mixed review notes fit-and-finish problems, specifically a rattling driver-side front window.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mention fit and finish, tight spaces, and trunk or garage fit for golf clubs and other items, but the sample is too varied or lacks enough context for a firm sentiment reading.

limitations: This cluster mixes at least two subjects: vehicle interior fit-and-finish quality and whether trunks, garages, golf bags, carts, or clubs physically fit.
Many examples are labeled undetermined, so the clearly interpretable sentiment evidence is limited.
Some fragments are very short or lack context, which restricts precise interpretation.
